Rashi on Ketubot 39a:1:1.hebrew: ומי מעברא - בקטנות או בנערות כשהיא בת קנס, שתלד בנערות:
Rashi on Ketubot 39a:1:1.english: And can she conceive - [that is,] during childhood or during young womanhood when she is subject to the fine, such that she would give birth during young womanhood?

Rashi on Ketubot 39a:1:2.hebrew: משמשות במוך - מותר להן לשמש במוך, ואינן כמשחיתות זרע:
Rashi on Ketubot 39a:1:2.english: Engage in relations with a [contraceptive] resorbent - It is permitted for them to engage in relations with a resorbent, and they are not like [those who] destroy seed.

Rashi on Ketubot 39a:1:3.hebrew: שמא יעשה עוברה סנדל - שאם תתעבר עובר שני, פוחת השני את צורת הראשון ודומה לסנדל, שהוא דג שבים:
Rashi on Ketubot 39a:1:3.english: Lest her fetus become a sandal - For if she conceives a second fetus, the second [fetus] diminishes the form of the first, and it resembles a sandal, which is a fish in the sea.

Rashi on Ketubot 39a:1:4.hebrew: שמא תגמול את בנה - מפני שהחלב נעכר כשמתעברת, ואינו טוב ליונק, ותצטרך להעתיקו משדים וימות:
Rashi on Ketubot 39a:1:4.english: Lest she wean her son - Because the milk becomes turbid when she conceives and is not good for the nursing [infant], and she will have to remove him from [her] breasts and he will die.

Rashi on Ketubot 39a:2:1.hebrew: פחות מכאן - מבת אחת עשרה שנה, משמשת כדרכה, לפי שלא תתעבר:
Rashi on Ketubot 39a:2:1.english: Less than that - [Younger] than eleven years old, she engages in relations in her usual manner, because she will not conceive.

Rashi on Ketubot 39a:2:2.hebrew: ויתר על כן - על בת שתים עשרה שנה, משמשת כדרכה, שאם תתעבר לא תמות. אלמא בקטנות לא מיעברא שיבא לכלל לידה, דהא "ותמות" קתני:
Rashi on Ketubot 39a:2:2.english: And more than that - [More] than twelve years old, she engages in relations in her usual manner, because if she conceives, she will not die. Thus, during [her] minority she does not conceive [to the extent] that she would come to childbirth, since [the baraita] teaches "and die."

Rashi on Ketubot 39a:3:1.hebrew: וכי תימא - מבת שתים עשרה ויום אחד, שהגיעו ימי הנעורים, נתעברה וילדה בנערות ומתה בנערות — הא נמי ליתא, דאמר שמואל: אין בין נערות לבגרות אלא ששה חדשים. משתביא שתי שערות הויא נערה — באותן שתביא משתים עשרה שנה והלאה — ומשתביאם עד שתבגור ששה חדשים ותו לא. ומתניתא דקתני מבת שתים עשרה ואילך אי מעברא לא מתה — במביאה שתי שערות קודם שתתעבר קאמר, אבל כל זמן שלא הביאה, קטנה היא. והאי דנקט מנין שנים, משום דבבציר משתים עשרה ויום אחד, אפילו הביאה שערות, אינו אלא שומא, כדאמרינן במסכת נדה ובקדושין:
Rashi on Ketubot 39a:3:1.english: And if you say - [That] from twelve years and one day old, when the days of young womanhood arrive, she conceived and gave birth as a young woman and died as a young woman — this too is not [possible], for Shmuel said: There are only six months between young womanhood and adulthood. From when she produces two [pubic] hairs, she is a young woman — [that is, with] those [hairs] that she produces from twelve years of age and onward — and from when she produces them until she becomes a grown woman is six months and no more. And the Baraita that teaches, "From twelve years old and onward, if she conceives she does not die," is speaking of one who produces two hairs before she conceives; however, as long as she has not produced [them], she is a minor. And the reason it stated a count of years is because at less than twelve years and one day, even if she produced hairs, it is nothing but a mole, as we say in Tractate Niddah and in Kiddushin.

Rashi on Ketubot 39a:4:1.hebrew: ופקע אב - פקעה תביעת אב, וזכה הלה במה שבידו, שאין בעל דינו קיים. וקנס לאו ממון הוא להורישו לאביה בתורת ירושה, כל כמה דלא גבתיה:
Rashi on Ketubot 39a:4:1.english: And [the right of] the father lapses - The father's claim lapses, and the other party retains what is in his possession, since his litigant is not alive. And a fine is not [considered] monetary property to bequeath it to her father by way of inheritance, as long as she has not collected it.

Rashi on Ketubot 39a:4:2.english: Or there is no grown-woman status in the grave - to nullify the father's claim.

Rashi on Ketubot 39a:4:3.hebrew: מר בר רב אשי - לא בעי לה בעיא דרבא משום בגר בקבר, אלא אם מתה בנערותה, מי פקעה כי בגרות דמחיים או לא. ולהאי לישנא דמר בר רב אשי אליבא דרבא, אמרו לעיל "מילתא דפשיטא ליה לאביי מיבעיא ליה לרבא", דאילו ללישנא קמא, מפשט פשיטא ליה לרבא דמיתה לא מפקעא — ודלא כאביי — כל זמן שלא בגרה, וכי קא מיבעיא ליה, בבגר בקבר קמבעיא ליה; אבל במיתה כל זמן שלא בגרה, פליג אדאביי ואמר לא מפקעא וחייב:
Rashi on Ketubot 39a:4:3.english: Mar bar Rav Ashi - [He] did not raise Rava's dilemma because of [the question of] reaching grown-woman status in the grave; rather, [he asked:] if she died during her maidenhood, does [her father's right] lapse like [with] grown-woman status during [her] lifetime or not? And according to this version of Mar bar Rav Ashi, [which is] according to Rava, they said above: "The matter that is obvious to Abaye is a dilemma to Rava." For according to the first version, it was completely obvious to Rava that death does not cause [the father's right] to lapse — unlike Abaye — as long as she has not reached grown-woman status, and when he raised a dilemma, he raised it regarding reaching grown-woman status in the grave; whereas regarding death as long as she has not reached grown-woman status, he disagrees with Abaye and says [that] it does not cause [the right] to lapse, and [the rapist] is liable.

Rashi on Ketubot 39a:4:4.hebrew: מיתה עושה בגרות - עושה דין בגרות, דמפקעא כח אב כי בגרות:
Rashi on Ketubot 39a:4:4.english: Death effects grown-woman status - [It] effects the legal status of a grown woman, in that it terminates the father's authority like grown-woman status.

Rashi on Ketubot 39a:5:1.english: What is [the law] - Does [the fine] belong to her father or to herself?

Rashi on Ketubot 39a:6:1.hebrew: בגרות מוציאה מרשות אב - דלא מצינו שזיכתה לו תורה בבתו אלא מכר בקטנות, ושאר שבח — כגון קנסה ומעשה ידיה — בנערות, כדילפינן בפרק נערה (לקמן כתובות דף מו:), אבל בבגרות לא אשכחן. וכיון דלא זיכתה לו תורה, אנן מהיכא תיתי לן לזכותו בשלה:
Rashi on Ketubot 39a:6:1.english: Grown-woman status removes [her] from [the] authority of [the] father - For we have not found that the Torah granted him [rights] in his daughter except sale during minority, and other benefits — such as her fine and her handiwork — during young-womanhood, as we derive in the chapter [entitled] Na'arah (below, Ketubot 46b), whereas in grown-womanhood we do not find [such rights]. And since the Torah did not grant [them] to him, from where would it occur to us to entitle him to what is hers?

Rashi on Ketubot 39a:6:2.hebrew: ונשואין מוציאין מרשות אב - כדאשכחן בהפרת נדרים, דכל זמן דלא ניסת אביה מיפר, ומשניסת אין יכול להפר:
Rashi on Ketubot 39a:6:2.english: And marriage removes [her] from [the] father's authority - As we find regarding the nullification of vows, that as long as she has not married her father nullifies [her vows], and once she has married he cannot nullify [them].

Rashi on Ketubot 39a:6:3.english: He had intercourse with her - When she was a young woman, and [then] she became a grown woman.

Rashi on Ketubot 39a:6:4.hebrew: לעצמה - דכתיב "ונתן האיש השוכב עמה לאבי הנערה", אם נערה היא בשעת נתינה:
Rashi on Ketubot 39a:6:4.english: To herself - For it is written: "And the man who lay with her shall give to the father of the young woman" — [that is,] if she is a young woman at the time of giving.

Rashi on Ketubot 39a:6:5.english: Her father and her husband - And [the vow] is not nullified until both of them nullify [it].

Rashi on Ketubot 39a:7:1.hebrew: בושת ופגם - במתני' לקמן [כתובות לט ע"ב] מפרש להו:
Rashi on Ketubot 39a:7:1.english: Humiliation and degradation - In the Mishnah below [Ketubot 39b], [it] explains them.

Rashi on Ketubot 39a:7:2.hebrew: האונס נותן מיד - לאביה, אע"פ שכונסה:
Rashi on Ketubot 39a:7:2.english: The rapist gives [payment] immediately - to her father, even though he marries her.

Rashi on Ketubot 39a:7:3.hebrew: לכשיוציא - בגמרא פריך [ע"ב]: אטו אשתו היא? ומפרש לה: לכשלא יכנוס, דאם כנסה אינו נותן קנס, כדכתיב "מהר ימהרנה לו, ואם מאן ימאן וגו' כסף ישקול". אבל אונס כתיב "ונתן חמשים כסף ולו תהיה לאשה":
Rashi on Ketubot 39a:7:3.english: When he releases [her] - In the Gemara [on 39b], it asks: Is she his wife [that he could release her]? And it explains it [to mean]: when he does not marry [her], for if he marries her, he does not pay [the] fine, as it is written: "He shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his [wife], and if [her father] utterly refuses, etc., he shall weigh out silver." However, [regarding] a rapist, it is written: "And he shall give fifty [shekels of] silver, and she shall be his wife."

Rashi on Ketubot 39a:7:4.hebrew: שותה בעציצו - בכלי שבחר לו לשתות בו, כלומר: על כרחו ישאנה, כדכתיב: "לא יוכל לשלחה" (דברים כ״ב:י״ט):
Rashi on Ketubot 39a:7:4.english: Drinks from his vessel - From the vessel that he chose for himself to drink from; that is to say, against his will he must marry her, as it is written: "he may not send her away" (Deuteronomy 22:19).

Tosafot on Ketubot 39a:1:1.hebrew: שלש נשים משמשות במוך - פי' בקונטרס: מותרות לשמש במוך, אע"ג דשאר נשים אסורות משום השחתת זרע. ואין נראה לר"ת, דהא קטנה ואילונית מותר לשמש בהדייהו ולא הוי השחתת זרע כיון שהוא דרך תשמיש. ומפרש ר"ת: "משמשות" — צריכות לשמש במוך אחר תשמיש, ועצה טובה קמ"ל. ולר"י נראה לקיים פי' הקונט', דבריש נדה (דף ג.) משמע שהמוך הוא במעיה כל שעה, והוי כמשמש על האבנים ועל העצים, ולא דמי למשמש קטנה ואילונית. ועוד, אפילו היתה נותנת מוך אחר תשמיש אסורה, דאף על פי שאינה מצווה על פריה ורביה מ"מ אסורה היא להשחית זרע, כדמשמע בנדה (דף יג.) דתנן: "כל היד המרבה לבדוק — בנשים משובחת, באנשים תיקצץ", ומפרש בגמרא משום דנשים לאו בנות הרגשה נינהו; משמע דאם היו בנות הרגשה הוו אסירי. ויש לדחות דלאו בנות איסור הרגשה נינהו קאמר:
Tosafot on Ketubot 39a:1:1.english: Three women engage in relations with a resorbent - Rashi explained [that this means] they are permitted to engage in relations with a resorbent, even though other women are forbidden [to do so] because of wasting seed. But this does not appear [correct] to Rabbeinu Tam, for it is permitted to engage in relations with a minor or an ailonit [a sexually underdeveloped woman], and it is not [considered] wasting seed since it is the normal manner of marital relations. Rather, Rabbeinu Tam explains: "They engage in relations" [means] they must use a resorbent after relations, and [the baraita] is teaching us good advice. And to R"I [Rabbeinu Yitzchak], it appears [possible] to uphold Rashi's explanation, for at the beginning of Niddah (3a) it is implied that the resorbent is in her womb at all times, and thus it is like one who engages in relations upon stones or wood, and it is not similar to one who engages in relations with a minor or an ailonit. Furthermore, even if she were to insert the resorbent after relations, it would be forbidden [for her to do so], because even though she is not commanded regarding procreation, she is nevertheless forbidden to destroy seed, as is implied in Niddah (13a), where we learned in a Mishnah: "Any hand that examines frequently — in women it is praiseworthy, in men it should be cut off," and the Gemara explains [this is] because women do not experience sensation; [this] implies that if they did experience sensation, they would be forbidden. However, one can reject [this proof, by saying] that [the Gemara] means they are not subject to the prohibition of sensation:

Tosafot on Ketubot 39a:3:1.hebrew: וכי תימא בציר הוא כו' והא בלבד קאמר - בקונטרס (בקדושין דף עט.) ל"ג ליה, דבלאו "בלבד" משמע טפי לא:
Tosafot on Ketubot 39a:3:1.english: "And if you say that it is less, etc., didn't he say 'only'?" - In the Kuntres [i.e., Rashi] (in Kiddushin 79a), he does not have this reading, for even without "only" it implies not more [than six months].

Tosafot on Ketubot 39a:5:1.hebrew: בא עליה ונתארסה מהו - לרבי עקיבא דמתני' קא מיבעיא ליה, דאמר נתארסה ונתגרשה קנסה לעצמה: דמי אמרינן כיון שיצאה מרשות האב לענין קנס, יהא קנסה לעצמה, או דלמא כיון דלענין שאר מילי לא נפקא מרשות האב, יהא קנסה לאביה? אבל לרבי עקיבא דברייתא פשיטא דקנסה לאביה. ולר' יוסי הגלילי, נהי דאמר אין לה קנס, נמי לא מיבעיא ליה; דהא דאין לה קנס, לאו משום מיפק מרשותא דאב היא, אלא גזירת הכתוב הוא דאין לה קנס, ולא נפקא באירוסין כלל מרשות אביה — דאב זכאי בקדושיה ובמעשה ידיה אע"ג דנתארסה. והא דקא בעי לה סתם, ולא קאמר לרבי עקיבא בהדיא מהו — משום דהלכה כר' עקיבא מחבירו:
Tosafot on Ketubot 39a:5:1.english: "If he had intercourse with her and she was betrothed, what is [the law]?" - He [Rava] is inquiring according to Rabbi Akiva of our Mishnah, who says [that if] she was betrothed and divorced, her fine belongs to her: for do we say that since she has left the father's jurisdiction with respect to the fine, her fine should belong to her; or perhaps, since with respect to other matters she has not left the father's jurisdiction, her fine should belong to her father? However, according to Rabbi Akiva of the baraita, it is obvious that her fine belongs to her father. And according to Rabbi Yosei HaGalili, although he says she has no fine, there is also no question [for Rava]; for the reason that she has no fine is not because of leaving the father's jurisdiction, rather it is a scriptural decree that she has no fine, and she does not leave her father's jurisdiction at all through betrothal — for the father is entitled to [the money of] her betrothal and to her handiwork even though she has been betrothed. And the reason he asks it anonymously, and does not explicitly say, "According to Rabbi Akiva, what is [the law]?" — is because the halakha follows Rabbi Akiva against his colleague [Rabbi Yosei HaGalili].

Tosafot on Ketubot 39a:6:1.hebrew: הואיל ונישואין מוציאין מרשות אב - פי' בקונט' דילפינן מהפרת נדרים. ואע"ג דקי"ל דממונא מאיסורא לא ילפינן, ה"מ לאוקמה ברשות אב — הוא דלא ילפינן ממונא מאיסורא; אבל לאפוקי מרשות אב, ילפינן שפיר מהפרת נדרים, דבסברא מועטת יש להוציאה מרשות אב. ור"י ב"ר אברהם פי': כיון דגלי לן קרא דלאוקמה ברשות אב איסורא וממונא שוין, ה"ה לאפוקה. [ור"י מפרש דנישואין מוציאין מרשות אב מדדרשינן: "איש אמו ואביו תיראו" — איש סיפק כו', אשה אין סיפק בידה לעשות; ולא נהירא, דמעשה ידיה אינו לבעל מן התורה]:
Tosafot on Ketubot 39a:6:1.english: "Since marriage removes [her] from [the] father's authority" - Rashi explained that we derive [this] from the annulment of vows. And even though we hold that we do not derive monetary matters from ritual law, that applies only to establishing her in [her] father's authority — it is in that case that we do not derive monetary matters from ritual law; however, to remove her from [her] father's authority, we may well derive [it] from the annulment of vows, for with a minimal reason we may remove her from [her] father's authority. And R. Yitzchak b. R. Avraham explained: Since a verse revealed to us that to establish her in [her] father's authority, ritual law and monetary matters are equal, the same applies to removing her [from his authority]. [And R. Yitzchak explains that marriage removes her from the father's authority from that which we expound: "A man shall fear his mother and his father" (Leviticus 19:3) — a man has the means [to do so], etc., a woman does not have the means to do so; but this does not seem right, since her handiwork does not belong to the husband by Torah law.]

Tosafot on Ketubot 39a:6:2.hebrew: מה בוגרת בא עליה ובגרה לעצמה - פירוש: דהא מצינו בוגרת שיוצאה מרשות אב לענין ממון. וקשה: דה"נ נישואין מוציאין מרשות אב לענין ממון, ואמאי צריך למילף מבוגרת? ונראה דבא עליה ובגרה לעצמה נפקא לן מונתן לאבי הנערה, דדרשינן: "לאבי הנערה" — ולא לאבי בוגרת:
Tosafot on Ketubot 39a:6:2.english: "Just as [with regard to] a bogeret, [if] he had intercourse with her and she became a bogeret, [the fine goes] to her" - Explanation: For we find that a bogeret leaves her father's authority with respect to monetary matters. And this is difficult: for so too, marriage removes [her] from her father's authority with respect to monetary matters, so why is it necessary to derive [marriage] from a bogeret? And it appears [that the rule that if] he had intercourse with her and she became a bogeret [the fine goes] to her is derived from [the verse] "And he shall give to the father of the na'arah" (Deuteronomy 22:29), for we expound: "to the father of the na'arah" — and not to the father of a bogeret.

Tosafot on Ketubot 39a:9:1.hebrew: צער דמאי - קשה לר"י: דמאי קא מיבעיא ליה? וכי לא ידע הש"ס שיש צער גדול לבתולה בביאה ראשונה, וכמה קטנות חולות מזה?! וכ"ת דמאותו צער פשיטא ליה להש"ס דפטור, שהרי סופה להצטער בכך תחת בעלה — והא איכא כמה תנאי בהכונס (ב"ק דף נט. ושם) דלא חיישי לכחש גופנא, פירוש: דבר שסופו להיות כן! ונראה לר"י, דצער בעילה משום תאות תשמיש אינו בא בשעת תשמיש אלא אחר כך; וכל צער החבלה דמחייב, היינו אותו צער הבא לו בשעת חבלה, אבל מה שבא לו אחר כך מיפטר, דגרמא בעלמא הוא. הלכך בעי: צער דמאי? ורשב"א מפרש: דפשיטא דצער של בתולים ליכא למימר, דע"כ תנא דמתני' חייש לכחש גופנא, מדמפתה פטור:
Tosafot on Ketubot 39a:9:1.english: "For what pain" - It is difficult for the Ri: What is [the Gemara] asking? Does the Talmud not know that a virgin has great pain during [her] first intercourse, and how many young girls fall ill from this?! And if you say that regarding that pain it is obvious to the Talmud that he is exempt, since she is destined to suffer this pain under her husband — surely there are several Tanna'im in [the chapter] HaKones (Bava Kamma 59a, and there) who are not concerned with "weakening of the body" [kachash gufna], meaning: something that is destined to happen anyway! And it appears to the Ri that the pain of intercourse, because of the desire of intercourse, does not come at the time of intercourse, but rather afterward; and all pain of wounding for which one is liable is that pain which comes to [the victim] at the time of the wound, whereas whatever comes to [the victim] afterward, one is exempt [from paying], for it is merely an indirect cause [gerama]. Therefore, [the Gemara] asks: "For what pain?" And the Rashba explains: It is obvious that one cannot say [it refers to] the pain of virginity, for perforce the Tanna of our Mishnah is concerned with "weakening of the body," since a seducer is exempt:
